description: Did this transaction pay USDC on Base to an address? Returns success, confirmations, every USDC transfer in the tx, the total received by `to`, and whether it meets `min`. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402 (MCP transport: an unpaid call returns the x402 PaymentRequired object; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over HTTP: GET /api/usdc-payment.
name: usdc_payment
title: USDC payment check on Base
